title: Sunday · the school, across the road
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The school from across the road on a Sunday in May, the doors shut, the steps, the road to the beach. Four months before Twenty Years; the strip goes to look at it first.
